name: Shirley Quadrivium — historic halls and glazed link

material_decisions.evidence: Three labelled facade samples in institutional-labelled-samples.json have raw CIEDE2000 3.589, 4.796 and 6.38 for mud bricks versus 6.737, 11.205 and 10.834 for red bricks. Minecraft mud bricks are an appearance proxy; the real walls are fired brick.

Architect and contractor specify limestone. Native pale-surround coupons favour restrained smooth quartz over coarse calcite or diorite. No exact vanilla limestone exists; no sandstone is asserted or used.

material_decisions.actual: pale small-unit coursed masonry, exact composition unresolved
material_decisions.evidence: SMP new-link photograph visibly separates these small pale units from carved historic limestone.
Three photographed roof regions vary strongly with lighting; keep the light gray family instead of uniformly dark deepslate.
Native full-cube mullions were too heavy. Thin bars preserve connected window geometry; their metal colour remains an imperfect vanilla substitute.

material_decisions.zone: all dark glazed openings and fine divisions
material_decisions.actual: clear/reflective glass with dark frames and sash
material_decisions.evidence: User explicit tinted-pane instruction and Sol appearance addendum e36916f6; reduce bright vanilla glass/iron lattice while preserving connected geometry.

evidence.supports: Three-storey central glazed gable, pale side panels and matched brick
Paired curved bays, three gabled dormers, central pointed limestone portal
East six-light groups, two pointed portals and stacked end-gable windows

uncertainties: Opening registration is interpreted; measured west wing has a genuine bend near U=-33.5 which is retained as two constant planes.
Roofer low frontage face 36 conflicts with photographed two-storey walls; straight wall paths continue above it while historic main roof faces remain preserved.
Rear opening rows are conservative interpretations, not verified photographic schedules.
Subvoxel limestone carving and historic sash mullions use a restrained quartz/iron-bar appearance proxy at two blocks per metre.
No native acceptance before inspection of this exact revision.
Glazed link and east-end windows re-registered to measured source ridge; older packet average-U positions are superseded by specific source geometry evidence.

material_review.scope: Existing coherent ordinary vanilla families; sparse iron bars proxy subvoxel sash fields. No registry substitution.

registration_corrections.evidence: Independent CityJSON extraction by Sol confirms source faces1/21 and their slanted front ridge U=-6.277,V=-8.318. Front glazing uses U=-6.25,V=-8.3, aligned within 0.04 m.
